name.description: Name of the mod. May be anything, but do note that GD usually has limits on what characters it can render.

repository.description: URL of the mod's Git repository, or other equivalent homepage.

developer.description: Name of the mod developer. If the mod has multiple developers, use a group name like "Geode Team"

id.description: ID of the mod. Recommended to be formatted as "developer.mod-name".

issues.description: Info about where and how to report bugs and other issues regarding the mod.

info.description: Free-form info about where and how to report issues. Supports markdown.

url.description: URL to open for posting issues. Usually the GitHub issues page.

incompatibilities.description: List of mods this mod is incompatible with.

version.description: Version of the incompatibility. May use wildcards (*) if a specific version is not required.

oneOf.title: The mod will not work at all or will have major bugs with the incompatibility installed.
The mod will work but can have minor bugs or issues with the incompatibility installed.

resources.description: The mod's resources. Used in conjunction with Geode CLI to automatically process & package resources for the mod.

fonts.description: Fonts to include with the mod. Provided format should be TTF / OTF. Fonts will be converted automatically into GD-compatible BM fonts by Geode CLI before packaging. List the names of the fonts as keys.

path.description: Path to the font's TTF / OTF file (relative to mod root folder).

charset.description: List of characters to include in the generated BM font. Default is "32-126,8226"

outline.description: If specified, will generate a black outline of the provided size around the font's characters.

files.description: Files to include with the mod. Things like sounds, binaries, etc.

items.description: Path to the file(s) to include, relative to the mod's root folder. Paths support wildcards, so one can for example include a bunch of image files using "resources/sounds/*.png".

sprites.description: Sprites to include with the mod. The sprites will automatically have UHD, HD and SD versions created of them.

items.description: Path to the file(s) to include, relative to the mod's root folder. Paths support wildcards, so one can for example include a bunch of image files using "resources/sprites/*.png".

spritesheets.description: The mod's sprite sheets. Sprite sheets are better optimized than using individual image files, so using them for the majority of the sprites in your mod is recommended. List the names of the mod's spritesheets as keys, and as their values a list of files to include in the sheet.

additionalProperties.description: A list of files to include in this spritesheet.

items.description: Path to the file(s) to include, relative to the mod's root folder. Paths support wildcards, so one can for example include a bunch of image files using "resources/sprites/*.png".

api.description: Define that this mod should be used as a dependency. If this key is present, the .lib file is automatically included in the .geode package.

include.description: Headers to include with the mod. Supports globbing.

items.description: Path to the header(s) to include, relative to the mod's root folder. Paths support wildcards, so one can for example include all headers using "include/*.hpp".

dependencies.description: List of mods this mod depends on.

settings.description: The mod's settings. These are editable by the user in-game, and are referenced by their ID.

early-load.description: Whether the mod should always be loaded before the loading screen or not.
